title: Concatenation of emitted segments
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, and an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string. For a segment $S$ starting at position $k$, let $a$ satisfy the emission property with postcondition $P$; suppose also that whenever $k+|S|\le i$, every configuration satisfying $P$ satisfies the emission property for a segment $T$ starting at $k+|S|$ with postcondition $Q$. Then the concatenated segment $S T$ starting at $k$ satisfies the emission property from $a$ with postcondition $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The initial emission property for $S$ and $a$ with postcondition $P$.
If $k+|S|\le i$, every configuration satisfying $P$ has the emission property for $T$ with postcondition $Q$.
